arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

tests = [
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 1.2 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a .5 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 5. b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 12 b', None),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 1E10 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 5.E10 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a .5E10 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a -12.1 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a +12.1 b'),
]

for t in tests:
    fmt, s = t[0], t[1]
    expected = t[2] if len(t) > 2 else float(s.split()[1])
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    result = r.fixed[0] if r else None
    match = (result == expected) if expected is not None else (r is None)
    print(f'{s!r:15s} -> {str(result):20s} (expected {expected}, match={match})')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
